capabilities: Drag nodes on a canvas with positions saved as a Mermaid comment
Add, remove and connect nodes and edges from a toolbar
Render wikilinks, tags, math and bold inside node labels via MarkdownRenderer
Two-way sync between Mermaid code edits and the visual canvas
extras: In beta and installed via BRAT or manually; community store submission planned for late May 2026. GUI editing works only in Reading view, toolbar is partly Japanese, and edge labels and node shapes can't be edited via GUI yet. Only graph LR/TD flowcharts are supported.
intentEvidence: The world's first inline GUI Mermaid editor for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams read-only, so editing them means hand-writing code or switching to an external tool.

relations.evidence: Mehrmaid — pioneered rich-markdown labels inside Mermaid nodes inside Obsidian (read-only)
Excalidraw for Obsidian — the canonical embedded React canvas plugin pattern
obsidian-enhancing-mindmap — bidirectional markdown ⇄ visual sync inside Obsidian

summary: Inline GUI editor that turns mermaid-maker code blocks into a draggable node canvas with rich-markdown labels, writing edits back to the Mermaid source.
